test_title: PYST 51: SSC CGL 2024 - General Knowledge (Held On 10 Sept, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which of the following books is INCORRECTLY paired with its respective author?

options.text: The Discovery of India – Subhash Chandra Bose
Why I am an Atheist – Bhagat Singh

solution:
The correct answer is __**The Discovery of India- Subhash Chandra Bose**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The incorrect pairing is:** **

 
 
• **The Discovery of India – Subhash Chandra Bose**
 
 
 
• The correct author of "The Discovery of India" is **Jawaharlal Nehru**. 
 
• He wrote this book while imprisoned in the Ahmednagar Fort during the Quit India Movement. 
 
• It is a reflection on Indian history and culture.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ** Hind Swaraj – Mahatma Gandhi**

 
 
• This pairing is **correct**.
 
• Mahatma Gandhi wrote "Hind Swaraj" in 1909, where he outlined his views on Swaraj (self-rule), modern civilization, and the path to Indian independence.
 
• It's a significant work in understanding Gandhi's philosophy and political thought.
 
 
 
• ** Gitanjali – Rabindranath Tagore**
 
 
• This pairing is also **correct**. "Gitanjali" is a collection of poems by Rabindranath Tagore, for which he was awarded the Nobel Prize in Literature in 1913.
 
• It's a beautiful collection of poems expressing spiritual and philosophical ideas.
 
 
 
• ** Why I am an Atheist – Bhagat Singh**
 
 
• This pairing is **correct** as well.
 
• Bhagat Singh, a prominent Indian revolutionary, wrote this essay expressing his views on atheism and the need for rational thinking.
 
• It's a significant text in understanding his intellectual and philosophical beliefs.
